displayName: OCI-WSTG10-006: Cryptography — Weak Hash Algorithm Usage
description:
Detects usage of weak hash algorithms (MD5, SHA1) in application transactions or certificate signatures

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_006", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%cryptography%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%weak%') AND "value" > 0
